import bpy, math, json, struct, zlib, hashlib
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
out=root/'assets/coast'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
# Retain all rejected versions for comparison. Only the new collection is exported.
for name in ['Coast_HarborOffice','Coast_LoadingProps']:
    old=bpy.data.collections.get(name)
    if old:
        old.name='Archive_PreCraft_'+name
        for o in old.objects:o.hide_set(True);o.hide_render=True
c=bpy.data.collections.new('Coast_CraftWarehouse')
bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(c)
ns={'bpy':bpy,'math':math,'np':np,'Vector':Vector,'Matrix':Matrix,'Path':Path,'root':root,'out':out,'c':c}
bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']=ns
# Author a dedicated atlas in the actual Blender session.
S=2048; W=512; H=256
rgba=np.zeros((S,S,4),dtype=np.float32);height=np.zeros((S,S),dtype=np.float32)
for slot in range(32):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(413+slot*719)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:H,0:W];u=xx/(W-1);v=yy/(H-1)
    if slot<12:base=np.array([160,128,94])*rng.uniform(.94,1.08)
    elif slot<20:base=np.array([174,115,81])*rng.uniform(.90,1.13)
    elif slot<24:base=np.array([132,113,86])*rng.uniform(.92,1.09)
    elif slot<28:base=np.array([174,151,114])*rng.uniform(.96,1.07)
    else:base=np.array([76,133,145])*rng.uniform(.90,1.10)
    phase=rng.uniform(0,6.28)
    flow=v+.014*np.sin(u*10+phase)+.006*np.sin(u*29-phase)
    knots=np.zeros_like(u)
    if slot<24 and slot%3!=0:
        kx=rng.uniform(.25,.78);ky=rng.uniform(.24,.76)
        dx=(u-kx)/.065;dy=(v-ky)/.15;r=np.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
        flow+=.040*np.exp(-dx*dx*.3)*np.tanh(dy*1.8)
        knots=-17*np.exp(-r*r*2.5)+4*np.cos(r*13)*np.exp(-r*r*.6)
    broad=5.4*np.sin(flow*24+phase)+2.8*np.sin(flow*52+np.sin(u*4))
    fibers=1.5*np.sin(flow*182+u*7)+.7*np.sin(flow*319-u*9)
    cracks=np.zeros_like(u)
    for j in range(5):
        cy=rng.uniform(.08,.92)
        line=cy+.004*np.sin(u*rng.uniform(9,24)+j)
        start=rng.uniform(.0,.75);end=min(1,start+rng.uniform(.09,.34))
        envelope=np.clip((u-start)/.018,0,1)*np.clip((end-u)/.018,0,1)
        cracks-=rng.uniform(7,15)*np.exp(-((v-line)/rng.uniform(.0018,.0034))**2)*envelope
    edge=np.minimum(v,1-v)
    wear=7*np.exp(-edge/.036)*(.65+.35*np.sin(u*35+phase)**2)
    endshade=-8*(np.exp(-u/.022)+np.exp(-(1-u)/.022))
    tone=broad+fibers+knots+cracks+wear+endshade
    if 24<=slot<28:
        r=np.sqrt(((u-.43)*1.6)**2+(v-.55)**2)
        tone=4*np.sin(r*96+np.sin(v*8))+2*np.sin(r*173)-5
    if slot>=28:
        # Worn paint follows the plank direction; no random white speckle field.
        worn=np.clip((np.sin(flow*67+phase)+.4*np.sin(u*24)-1.10)*2.7,0,1)
        worn=np.maximum(worn,.45*np.exp(-edge/.021)*(.5+.5*np.sin(u*43)))
        wood=np.array([166,138,99])[None,None,:]+tone[:,:,None]*.7
        rgb=(base[None,None,:]+tone[:,:,None]*.7)*(1-worn[:,:,None])+wood*worn[:,:,None]
    else:rgb=base[None,None,:]+tone[:,:,None]*np.array([1,.84,.65])
    # Eight-pixel border protects islands under mipmaps.
    rgb[:8]=rgb[8];rgb[-8:]=rgb[-9];rgb[:,:8]=rgb[:,8:9];rgb[:,-8:]=rgb[:,-9:-8]
    a=(slot//4)*H;b=(slot%4)*W
    rgba[a:a+H,b:b+W,:3]=np.clip(rgb/255,0,1);rgba[a:a+H,b:b+W,3]=1
    height[a:a+H,b:b+W]=tone/80
gy,gx=np.gradient(height)
normal=np.stack((-gx*1.8,-gy*1.8,np.ones_like(gx)),axis=-1)
normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
norm=np.ones_like(rgba);norm[:,:,:3]=normal*.5+.5
def png(path,arr):
    data=np.ascontiguousarray(np.flipud(np.clip(arr*255+.5,0,255).astype(np.uint8)))
    def ch(t,b):return struct.pack('>I',len(b))+t+b+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+b)&0xffffffff)
    raw=b''.join(b'\0'+row.tobytes() for row in data)
    path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ch(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',arr.shape[1],arr.shape[0],8,6,0,0,0))+ch(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,6))+ch(b'IEND',b''))
def material(name,color,rough=.86):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name);m.use_nodes=True
    bs=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    bs.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1);bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough
    bs.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.24
    return m
def texture_material(name,albedo,normal_data,rough):
    png(out/(name+'_albedo.png'),albedo);png(out/(name+'_normal.png'),normal_data)
    m=material(name,(1,1,1),rough);bs=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    for role in ['albedo','normal']:
        im=bpy.data.images.load(str(out/(name+'_'+role+'.png')),check_existing=False)
        im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if role=='albedo' else 'Non-Color'
        im.pack()
        t=m.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');t.image=im;t.interpolation='Linear'
        if role=='albedo':m.node_tree.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],bs.inputs['Base Color'])
        else:
            nm=m.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap');nm.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.55
            m.node_tree.links.new(t.outputs['Color'],nm.inputs['Color']);m.node_tree.links.new(nm.outputs['Normal'],bs.inputs['Normal'])
    return m
wood=texture_material('HarborCraft_Timber',rgba,norm,.86)
# A small seamless, oriented fiber texture for all actual rope geometry.
yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:256,0:256];u=xx/256;v=yy/256
wave=np.sin(math.tau*(v*3-u*2));fiber=np.sin(math.tau*(v*21-u*14))
rt=8*wave+1.7*fiber
ra=np.ones((256,256,4),dtype=np.float32);ra[:,:,:3]=(np.array([183,164,121])+rt[:,:,None]*np.array([1,.9,.65]))/255
rh=(wave*.7+fiber*.06);gy,gx=np.gradient(rh)
rn=np.stack((-gx*2,-gy*2,np.ones_like(gx)),axis=-1);rn/=np.linalg.norm(rn,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
rna=np.ones_like(ra);rna[:,:,:3]=rn*.5+.5
rope=texture_material('HarborCraft_Hemp',ra,rna,.93)
iron=material('HarborCraft_OxidizedIron',(.105,.125,.119),.77)
glass=material('HarborCraft_WindowShade',(.055,.12,.13),.42)
stone=material('HarborCraft_Footing',(.32,.35,.30),.96)
lamp=material('HarborCraft_LampPane',(.63,.48,.26),.64)
ns.update({'wood':wood,'rope':rope,'iron':iron,'glass':glass,'stone':stone,'lamp':lamp})
print('CRAFT_ATLAS_READY',str(out), '32 islands each 512x256; isolated collection ready')
